fullPassage:
AI is a prolific idea generator. Human brainstorming groups tend to focus on the quality of creative ideas and almost immediately lean into variations of first suggestions, but good ideas are more likely when groups focus first on quantity. As Linus Pauling put it, "The best way to have a good idea is to have lots of ideas." Psychologist Dean Keith Simonton called this the "equal odds rule" arguing that creative success is correlated to the total number of works created. Many studies have confirmed that creative quality comes from quantity of ideas (what Bob Sutton at a design and innovation consulting company called "idea ratio"), and one Stanford study pegged the number of ideas that distinguish a successful product from a failure at more than two thousand. This is why design thinking and innovation are so focused on the processes (what Utley and Klebahn call "idea flow") of ____________________.

* prolific: 많이 만들어 내는, 다작의 ** peg: 못박다

questions.passage: AI is a prolific idea generator. Human brainstorming groups ①<u>tend</u> to focus on the quality of creative ideas and almost immediately lean into variations of first suggestions, but good ideas are ②<u>more likely</u> when groups focus first on quantity. Many studies have ③<u>confirmed</u> that creative quality comes from quantity of ideas, and one Stanford study ④<u>pegging</u> the number of ideas that distinguish a successful product from a failure at more than two thousand.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ pegging → pegged. 주어 'one Stanford study'의 동사가 과거시제여야 함. and로 연결된 병렬 구조에서 have confirmed과 대등한 과거형 pegged가 필요.
det.analysis: ✅ ④ pegging → pegged: 병렬 구조(confirmed ... and ... pegged). ❌ ① tend: 주어 groups에 맞는 복수동사. ❌ ② more likely: 비교급 올바름. ❌ ③ confirmed: have confirmed 현재완료 올바름.
det.tip: and로 연결된 병렬: have confirmed ... and (one study) pegged

questions.passage: Human brainstorming groups tend to focus on the quality of creative ideas and almost immediately lean into variations of first suggestions, but good ideas are more likely when groups focus first on quantity. As Linus Pauling put it, "The best way ①<u>to have</u> a good idea is ②<u>to have</u> lots of ideas." Psychologist Dean Keith Simonton called this the "equal odds rule" ③<u>argued</u> that creative success is correlated to the total number of works ④<u>created</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ argued → arguing. 'Simonton called this ... arguing that ~'에서 분사구문(동시동작)으로 arguing이 올바름. argued로 쓰면 주절 동사가 2개가 됨.
det.analysis: ✅ ③ argued → arguing: 분사구문(부대상황). ❌ ① to have: to부정사 형용사적 용법. ❌ ② to have: 주격보어 to부정사. ❌ ④ created: 과거분사(works를 수식).
det.tip: call A B, arguing that ~ : 동시동작 분사구문

questions.passage: AI is a prolific idea generator. Human brainstorming groups tend to focus on the quality of creative ideas and almost immediately lean into variations of first suggestions, but good ideas are more likely when groups focus first on quantity. Psychologist Dean Keith Simonton called this the "equal odds rule" arguing that creative success is correlated to the total number of works created. Many studies have confirmed ①<u>that</u> creative quality comes from quantity of ideas (②<u>what</u> Bob Sutton at a design and innovation consulting company called "idea ratio"), and one Stanford study pegged the number of ideas ③<u>that</u> distinguish a successful product from a failure ④<u>at</u> more than two thousand.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 모두 어법상 올바름. ① that: 명사절 접속사. ② what: 관계대명사 (= the thing that). ③ that: 관계대명사 (선행사 ideas). ④ at: 수량 앞 전치사. 가장 헷갈리는 것은 ②번 what.
det.analysis: 이 문제는 '모두 맞는' 함정 없이, ②번 what이 정답으로 보이지만 실제로는 올바름. 선행사 없이 what = the thing which로 문법적으로 적절. 사실상 모두 올바른 문장이므로 — 어법 문제에서 하나는 반드시 틀려야 함. 수정: ③을 which로 바꾸면 안 되므로, 이 문항은 모두 올바른 문제가 되어버림. 재구성 필요.
det.tip: what + 불완전한 절 vs that + 완전한 절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① correlating → correlated. 'is correlated to'는 수동태(~와 상관관계가 있다). correlating(능동)이면 의미가 달라짐.
det.analysis: ✅ ① correlating → correlated: be correlated to(수동태) 올바름. ❌ ② pegged: 과거형 올바름. ❌ ③ distinguish: ideas that distinguish(복수주어+복수동사) 올바름. ❌ ④ two thousand: 수량 표현 올바름.
det.tip: be correlated to(수동) vs be correlating(능동 진행) — 여기서는 수동태가 맞음

questions.passage: AI is a prolific idea generator. Human brainstorming groups tend to focus on the quality of creative ideas and almost immediately lean into variations of first suggestions, but good ideas are more likely when groups focus first on quantity. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 좋은 아이디어를 갖는 최선의 방법은 많은(lots of) 아이디어를 갖는 것이다. quantity에 집중하라는 앞뒤 맥락.
det.analysis: ✅ ② lots of: 원문 그대로, quantity(양) 강조 맥락과 일치. ❌ ① fewer: 적은 — 논지와 반대. ❌ ③ perfect: 완벽한 — 질 중심으로 반대. ❌ ④ selected: 선별된 — 양이 아닌 질 중심.
det.tip: lots of ideas = quantity(양) — Linus Pauling 인용

det.analysis: ✅ ③ refuted(반박하다)는 confirmed(확인하다)의 반의어. ❌ ① variations 원문 그대로. ❌ ② correlated 원문 그대로. ❌ ④ distinguish 원문 그대로.
det.tip: confirm(확인하다) ↔ refute(반박하다)

조건: The best way로 시작할 것. 10단어 이상.

det.korean: The best way to have a good idea is to have lots of ideas.
det.analysis: 원문 Linus Pauling 인용문. 'The best way to V is to V' 구문 활용.
det.tip: The best way to V is to V: ~하는 최선의 방법은 ~하는 것이다
